clips.name: Sir Imbert
clips.content_text: It is my oath! I will fight until the magic is gone from this realm!

clips.name: Ywaleth Yoster
clips.content_text: The footprints lead in this direction. I'm on the trail!

clips.name: Linlos Dustman
clips.content_text: I spoke with an ant the other day, but I didn't understand what he said. I guess I'm not so good at talking to animals.

clips.name: Koba
clips.content_text: On behalf of all the outcasts and who have been called monsters... I will show them the REAL MONSTER!

clips.name: Lavena Vol
clips.content_text: And they call these spells forbidden magic. Ha! What's the worst that could happen anyway?

clips.name: Witch
clips.content_text: Oh dear! Did that hurt, dearie?

clips.name: Witch
clips.content_text: No! My magic! My beautiful magic!

clips.name: Vampire Lord
clips.content_text: I have buried kings greater than you!

clips.name: Vampire Lord
clips.content_text: I can hear your heart trembling!
